column2: Paste this before every Map Art Direction: "Stylized illustrated fantasy dungeon map, painterly digital art with clean bold shapes and soft cel-shaded lighting, whimsical and expressive young-adult tone matching a modern indie RPG card game, rich saturated colors with warm key light and colored shadows. A high three-quarter top-down view of the entire location like a detailed diorama. A clear, readable winding path network connects distinct, EMPTY, flat circular landing spots (slightly lighter ground, each with room for a round icon about 8% of the image width), placed at the positions described. Paths must visibly connect the spots exactly as described, including side branches that dead-end. Decorative detail everywhere else. No text, no letters, no numbers, no icons, no UI, no characters standing on the landing spots, no border. 3:2 landscape, 1536x1024."

The game overlays node icons on the map at the x%, y% positions in Node Layout (x = % from the left edge, y = % from the top). The art only needs empty landing spots at roughly those positions; after the image is imported, Claude Code views it and fine-tunes node coordinates so icons sit exactly on the spots. File naming: save each map as its Map Image ID (e.g. MAP-HOG.png) and each battleboard as its Battleboard ID (e.g. BB-HOG.png).
